ros2_control configuration for the real robot.

       Drivetrain: STM32F411 over UART through src/mower_hardware
       (firmware/UART_OPEN_LOOP_PROTOCOL.md). The firmware itself lives in
       firmware/ and the container flashes it at start-up (firmware-sync), so
       driver and firmware always come from the same build.

       Device paths are the udev names from usb.rules; deploy/docker-compose.yaml
       passes them into the container. /dev/stmcom is the LubanCat UART3
       (/dev/ttyS3) or a USB-serial adapter on a bench. --><ros2_control name="RealRobot" type="system"><hardware><plugin>mower_hardware/MowerSystem</plugin><param name="device">/dev/stmcom</param><param name="baud">115200</param><!-- firmware: 1000 permille == wheel_max_rpm (58 rpm) --><param name="max_rpm">58.0</param><!-- FT-555 16 PPR x4 (quadrature) x 139:1 gearbox --><param name="counts_per_rev">8896</param><!-- sent in every 0x01 frame; the firmware stops if no command arrives within this --><param name="command_timeout_ms">300</param><!-- the driver zeroes reported velocity if no 0x85 feedback within this --><param name="feedback_timeout_s">0.5</param><!-- Power button held 3 s: the STM32 asks the host to halt. Inside the
           container there is no systemd, so hand the request to the host
           (deploy/host/mower-host-request.service watches this file). --><param name="shutdown_command">/usr/local/bin/mower-host-request poweroff</param><!-- 0x87 build identity, latched JSON; /robot/info merges it --><param name="firmware_info_topic">/mower_base/firmware_info</param></hardware><!-- Left Wheel Joint --><joint name="left_wheel_joint"><command_interface name="velocity"><param name="min">-6.1</param><param name="max">6.1</param></command_interface><state_interface name="position"/><state_interface name="velocity"/></joint><!-- Right Wheel Joint --><joint name="right_wheel_joint"><command_interface name="velocity"><param name="min">-6.1</param><param name="max">6.1</param></command_interface><state_interface name="position"/><state_interface name="velocity"/></joint><!-- The blade (mower_joint) is not driven through ros2_control on the
         real robot: production blade actuation is disabled and the legacy
         mower_controller/MowerSystemHardware effort path was a no-op. --></ros2_control></robot>
